I’ll verify references and completion criteria, since we reviewed everything. I’ll also improve the phrase about "candidate copy" for clarity.**Clarifying the structure**

I'll document the changes made, including the reasons for them, and ensure everything has been reviewed without leaving any unreviewed scope. I won't mention retiring any skills, as there's only one involved here. The directory will include a complete listing, focusing only on the continual arc and relevant files. No irrelevant statements are needed.

The skill description and branch triggers now point to those procedures. Kept the compact tile-summary guidance in the main file.

I found no other skills to consolidate or retire. Read the complete directory listing and all skill and supporting files; after editing, reread the resulting files and checked that the branch references resolve and each retained branch has a clear trigger and verification steps. No scope remains unreviewed in this directory.
